digest.component_or_area: dispatch coordinator for atomic non-create operations
propositions: Coordinator executes non-create atomic postconditions (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) once in dependency order through S1 budget
Late failure preserves proven earlier postconditions; remaining drift is re-observed and re-planned in the next reconcile pass, not replayed mid-pass
Delete operations treat already-gone resources as idempotent success; ticket-local 404/permanent 4xx failures isolate to ticket scope while broad failures stop only their declared scope
Normalized Disposition vocabulary maps to five exact outcome buckets: applied, recovered, deferred, failed, skipped; per-ticket tallies distinguish these without overlapping projections
Coordinator operates as shadow/additive routing alongside legacy dispatch; new leaves in typed_dispatch are non-breaking while existing atomic executors (update_one, label/parent helpers) are reused
